title: lab-report-corpus: synthetic laboratory reports with a computed answer key for document AI and OCR
description: 4,000 fictional laboratory reports in six national conventions and 14 layouts, as born-digital PDFs and page pictures in three conditions, each with a machine-readable answer key and tagged hard cases. All people, laboratories and values are invented. An extension of lab-reading-bench v0.4.1.
notes: Data (PDFs, pictures, answer keys, tables, baseline results) under CC BY 4.0; code (corpus/*.mts, corpus/*.py, readers/) under MIT.
